_rule: Only issues Suresh has publicly named (fact issues.named). Six stories, not a manifesto. Each has a 'what he has said or done' anchor. Do NOT add a policy position he has not published. Do NOT write a number he has not published.

issues.title: Places to play
issues.dek: A new city gets its parks and fields once. It is worth getting them right.
issues.body: Suresh started a sports club in 2020 because there was nowhere organized for kids and parents to play together yet. Six years of volleyball, badminton and ping pong later, the demand is not a theory — it is a waitlist. Improved recreation facilities is one of the issues he has named since 2024, and it is the one he has the longest receipt for.
issues.anchor: Founded MHSRC in 2020; runs tournaments, workshops and festivals.

issues.title: Traffic and getting home
issues.dek: Mountain House is a commuter town that grew faster than its roads.
issues.body: Traffic improvements is on the short list of issues Suresh has publicly named. He has not published a road plan and this site will not invent one for him. What he has said is that residents' concerns belong in front of the board, and that showing up at meetings to carry them is part of the job.
issues.anchor: Named traffic as a priority in his 2024 candidate statement.

issues.title: Water and utility bills
issues.dek: The bill that arrives every month is the most-discussed policy in town.
issues.body: Water and utility bills is one of the issues Suresh named in 2024. It is also the thing residents raise first in a new city, where rates, service districts and the transition to city governance are all still settling. He has committed to bringing that to the dais, not to a number he cannot yet promise.
issues.anchor: Named water and utility bills as a priority in his 2024 candidate statement.

issues.title: Public safety and being ready
issues.dek: Emergency preparedness and neighborhood watch, at neighborhood scale.
issues.body: Public safety, emergency preparedness and neighborhood watch appear together in his published issues, and they share a method: they work when neighbors already know each other. That is the same argument as the sports club, applied to a harder subject.
issues.anchor: Named public safety, emergency preparedness and neighborhood watch in 2024.

issues.title: A new city's economy
issues.dek: Economic development, and somewhere for local businesses to be seen.
issues.body: Economic development for a new city is on his list, and the club he founded already runs a local business expo — a small, concrete version of the same idea. Education is on the list too. Both are areas where a council member's real power is convening people, which is the thing he has demonstrably done for six years.
issues.anchor: MHSRC runs a local business expo; named economic development and education in 2024.

issues.title: A place to show what you can do
issues.dek: Platforms for residents to showcase talent — his words, and his track record.
issues.body: Cultural performances, festivals, tournaments, art and fitness workshops. In a city this young and this diverse, the events where people show up as themselves are not decoration; they are how a population becomes a community. He has been building that since before there was a city to build it for.
issues.anchor: Six years of MHSRC cultural events, festivals and workshops.
